title: AS2 compiler: substring/length/newline built-ins missing native opcodes
description:
Three AVM1 global identifiers/functions are not special-cased in compiler.ts and fall through to generic ActionCallFunction or variable lookup:

1. substring(s, offset, count) → should emit ActionMBSubString (0x35). Compile: arg0(s), arg1(offset), arg2(count), push count(3), emit 0x35. AS2 signature: substring(string, start, length).
2. length(s) → should emit ActionMBLength (0x31). Compile: arg0(s), push count(1), emit 0x31. But note: String.prototype.length is a property not a call — only the global length(str) function needs 0x31.
3. newline → the identifier 'newline' is a global constant equal to '\r' in AVM1. In compiler.ts scanExpr/compileExpr, intercept Identifier('newline') and emit ActionPush string '\r'.

Fix all three in packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts. Add exclusions to collectStrings for substring and length function name identifiers. Add tests in a new test file packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/string-builtins.test.ts covering: correct opcodes, no ActionCallFunction fallthrough, no name in constant pool, newline literal value.
